confidence_notes: Restaurant and coffee anchors rest on several aggregator sources (CityCost, WhereAndWhen, Nomad Ranker, Square Yards) that differ in method and date, so they are rough. Beer is based on a Rajasthan-wide draft average and an older domestic pint figure, not Jaipur-specific data. Cocktail and wine are inferred from the beer anchor, not from direct price data. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Jaipur's budget and mid-range market; no accommodation searches were run and no live listings were checked. The FX observation could not be confirmed as the latest published RBA rate: the search returned only an RBA page snapshot for 20 March 2026, so it is stale relative to the generation date and should be refreshed from the RBA F11 table before use.
comparable_city_reasoning: No comparable city was used. Anchors are based on Jaipur-specific aggregator figures for food and drink, with accommodation set by holistic estimate from Jaipur's general tourist market.
